summary: Tested the Further Work follow-up and the Further Parts to parts request features. Backend: 10/11 new pytest pass, 1 skipped (the MOD desk case, because the admin org isn't an operator org here), and the 23 regression tests from iterations 295/296 still pass. The one failure is a cross-tenant write bug: link_follow_up() looks up the original case by id with no organization check. Frontend: the full flow in the Service Desk case drawer works. Completed case > Details > Book follow-up opens 'Book follow-up visit' with the title and description prefilled. After Log case, the 'Follow-up booked · SVC-xxxxx' badge shows and is still there after a reload. The timeline shows the note with the moved parts, and the DB link and parts move are correct.

critical.issue: Cross-tenant write. utils/engineer_report.link_follow_up does db.svc_cases.find_one({'id': original_id}) with no org filter. Any logged-in user in another org (reproduced with owner@isodemo.com against an admin-org case) can set follow_up_case_id/reference on a foreign case, move its svc_parts_requests onto their own case (case_id changes, so the parts leave the original org's flow), and add timeline events to the foreign case. Fix: only link when orig.organization_id == new_case.organization_id, or when the caller is allowed to see the case via as_case_org. Otherwise ignore follow_up_of or return 403. Also add organization_id to the parts update_many filter.

minor.issue: The idempotency check uses {'case_id': case.id, source}. After a follow-up is booked, the requests are moved (case_id changes), so a re-complete or re-open of the original raises duplicate parts requests. Check origin_case_id instead.
There is no guard against a second follow-up. Posting follow_up_of again overwrites follow_up_case_id/reference on the original. The UI stops this through existing_follow_up, but the API doesn't.

The draft doesn't carry the original case's contact (contact_id, customer_name, phone, email), company_id, cover_type or priority. The desk has to re-enter the contact: submit fails with 'Pick a contact (or switch to manual entry)'. That makes it less than one-tap.

Code review only, not testable here. The draft works for MOD cases through as_case_org, but _create_case uses the user's home org. A follow-up booked from a MOD case would be created in the operator org, and the MOD parts requests would be moved onto a case in another org. Use the original case's org when as_case_org re-scopes the user.

issues: The 'Follow-up booked · SVC-xxxxx' badge is plain text. Making it a link that opens the follow-up case would help.
The case drawer has no back-link to the original from the follow-up (the follow_up_of_reference field is stored but not shown).

action_items: HIGH: In link_follow_up, scope the original case lookup to the new case's org (or the as_case_org scope) and add organization_id to the parts update_many filter. Reject or ignore a foreign follow_up_of.
Book MOD follow-ups in the MOD org when the desk user is re-scoped through as_case_org.
Block or ignore a second follow_up_of once the original already has follow_up_case_id.
Prefill contact, customer, company, cover type and priority in follow-up-draft and the intake form.
critical_code_review_comments: link_follow_up trusts the client's follow_up_of without a tenant check (see the critical issue). It is reachable from portal intake too.
The intake form only uses initial.siteId when the site is in the loaded list. Cases without a site_id (legacy) need a manual site pick, which is fine but worth noting.
BookFollowUpButton uses a raw axios call with a localStorage token, while the rest of the code is moving to the cookie session api helper. Inconsistent but working.
seed_data_creation: Only TEST_ cases and parts requests, all cleaned by id. The UI run created follow-up case SVC-00005 in the admin org. It was deleted, but the reference counter advanced.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend/tests && pytest test_iter297_follow_up_parts_link.py test_engineer_report_asset_list.py test_iter296_engineer_report_retest.py -p no:xdist -o addopts=''. test_cross_tenant_follow_up_of_does_not_touch_other_org should pass after the fix. UI: python tests/_seed_ui_297.py seed, log in as admin through the API token in localStorage, open /service-desk > Cases, set filter-status=closed, search TEST-U297FU, open the row, then drawer-tab-details > book-follow-up-btn. In the form: intake-site-select, 'Enter manually', intake-contact-name/phone, then intake-submit. Expect follow-up-booked. Afterwards run python tests/_seed_ui_297.py clean.
rca of the issue: Cross-tenant: _create_case passes payload.follow_up_of straight to link_follow_up, which looks up svc_cases by id only and then updates the original and its parts requests. Repro: owner@isodemo.com POSTs /api/svc/intake/phone {title, follow_up_of: <admin-org case id>}. The admin-org case then gets follow_up_case_id set and its parts requests are moved. Mitigation: add an organization_id match (or as_case_org scope) to the orig lookup and to the parts update_many.
